Sophie — thanks for sending. A couple quick items before we can finish PO activation:

1) The certificate as sent does not include the endorsement naming Redwood Inference as an Additional Insured. We require an Additional Insured endorsement (ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent) showing Redwood Inference, Inc. as additional insured on the General Liability policy.

2) We also need Primary and Non-Contributory language or an explicit Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood.

I've attached a COI template that calls out the exact endorsement language and the legal name we need shown. Please have your broker issue an updated COI/endorsement and return a scanned copy.

3) When you send the updated certificate, please reference PO #450328 in the subject line so Finance can link the document to the PO and clear invoices automatically.

Attachment: Redwood_COI_template.pdf (PDF, 64 KB)

If you can get the endorsement in the next 24–48 hours we'll complete the activation the same day it's received.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
